zh.name: 视觉效果拆解教程
zh.summary: 先展示一个明确效果，再拆出生成它的材质、光线、处理或步骤。
zh.useWhen: 每一解释都指向可见效果；AI、平面、像素插画是表达变体。
zh.instructions: 成品、处理前素材、关键参数与操作依据
zh.output: 一组保留本模板风格、叙事与钩子的 Instagram 图文。

en.name: Visual Effect Breakdown
en.summary: Create an Instagram how-to carousel using the visual effect breakdown structure. Preserve its visual hierarchy, sequence and opening payoff.
en.useWhen: Use when your content needs the visual effect breakdown format.
en.instructions: Provide your topic, audience, usable source material and confirmed facts.
en.output: An editable Instagram carousel with this template’s sequence and visual style.

imageCues: 封面以实际转化结果占主导，小原图嵌窗与弯箭头建立前后关系
